<h2 id="overleaf部署">overleaf部署</h2>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>注意</strong>：直接运行下载docker-compose.yml，会报version问题，把第一行的version注释即可</p>
</blockquote>
<ol>
<li>
<h4 id="编写配置文件docker-composeyml--总的">编写配置文件docker-compose.yml  (总的）</h4>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">services:

    # MongoDB 主节点（node1）
    mongo-node1:
        image: mongo:latest  # 版本按需改4.4
        container_name: mongo-node1
        ports:
            - "27017:27017"
        volumes:
            - D:/docker/volumes/mongo/data/node1:/data/db
            - D:/docker/volumes/mongo/logs/node1:/var/log/mongodb
        command: mongod --replSet rs_overleaf --bind_ip 0.0.0.0
        networks:
            - overleaf-network
        restart: always
        healthcheck:
            test: echo 'db.runCommand("ping").ok' | mongosh localhost:27017/test --quiet
            interval: 10s
            timeout: 10s
            retries: 5
            start_period: 30s

    # MongoDB 从节点（node2）
    mongo-node2:
        image: mongo:latest
        container_name: mongo-node2
        ports:
            - "27018:27017"
        volumes:
            - D:/docker/volumes/mongo/data/node2:/data/db
            - D:/docker/volumes/mongo/logs/node2:/var/log/mongodb
        command: mongod --replSet rs_overleaf --bind_ip 0.0.0.0
        networks:
            - overleaf-network
        restart: always
        depends_on:
            - mongo-node1
        healthcheck:
            test: echo 'db.runCommand("ping").ok' | mongosh localhost:27017/test --quiet
            interval: 10s
            timeout: 10s
            retries: 5
            start_period: 30s
</code></pre>
<pre><code> redis:
     restart: always
     image: redis:latest
     container_name: redis
     expose:
         - 6379
     volumes:
         - D:/docker/volumes/redis:/data
     command: redis-server --appendonly yes
     networks:
         - overleaf-network
     healthcheck:
         test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
         interval: 10s
         timeout: 5s
         retries: 5


 overleaf:
     restart: always
     # Server Pro users:
     # image: quay.io/overleaf/overleaf-pro
     image: sharelatex/sharelatex:5.0-with-texlive-full
     # image: sharelatex/sharelatex:5
     container_name: overleaf
     depends_on:
         mongo-node1:
             condition: service_healthy
         mongo-node2:
             condition: service_healthy
         redis:
             condition: service_started
     ports:
         - 9500:80
     links:
         - mongo-node1
         - mongo-node2
         - redis
     volumes:
         - D:/docker/volumes/overleaf:/var/lib/overleaf
         ########################################################################
         ####  Server Pro: Uncomment the following line to mount the docker  ####
         ####             socket, required for Sibling Containers to work    ####
         ########################################################################
         # - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
     environment:

         OVERLEAF_APP_NAME: Overleaf Community Edition

         #OVERLEAF_MONGO_URL: mongodb://mongo/overleaf?replicaSet=rs0
         OVERLEAF_MONGO_URL: mongodb://mongo-node1:27017,mongo-node2:27017/overleaf?replicaSet=rs_overleaf&amp;w=majority&amp;readPreference=primary

         # Same property, unfortunately with different names in
         # different locations
         OVERLEAF_REDIS_HOST: redis
         REDIS_HOST: redis

         ENABLED_LINKED_FILE_TYPES: 'url,project_file'

         # Enables Thumbnail generation using ImageMagick
         ENABLE_CONVERSIONS: 'true'

         # Disables email confirmation requirement
         EMAIL_CONFIRMATION_DISABLED: 'true'

         # temporary fix for LuaLaTex compiles
         # see https://github.com/overleaf/overleaf/issues/695
         TEXMFVAR: /var/lib/overleaf/tmp/texmf-var

         ## Set for SSL via nginx-proxy
         #VIRTUAL_HOST: 103.112.212.22

         # OVERLEAF_SITE_URL: http://overleaf.mydomain.com
         OVERLEAF_NAV_TITLE: Our OVERLEAF Instance
         # OVERLEAF_HEADER_IMAGE_URL: http://somewhere.com/mylogo.png
         OVERLEAF_ADMIN_EMAIL: cccc@qq.com

         # OVERLEAF_LEFT_FOOTER: '[{"text": "Powered by &lt;a href=\"https://www.overleaf.com\"&gt;Overleaf&lt;/a&gt; 2016"},{"text": "Another page I want to link to can be found &lt;a href=\"here\"&gt;here&lt;/a&gt;"} ]'
         # OVERLEAF_RIGHT_FOOTER: '[{"text": "Hello I am on the Right"} ]'

         OVERLEAF_EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS: "cccc@qq.com"

         # OVERLEAF_EMAIL_AWS_SES_ACCESS_KEY_ID:
         # OVERLEAF_EMAIL_AWS_SES_SECRET_KEY:

         OVERLEAF_EMAIL_SMTP_HOST: smtp.qq.com
         OVERLEAF_EMAIL_SMTP_PORT: 465
         OVERLEAF_EMAIL_SMTP_SECURE: true
         OVERLEAF_EMAIL_SMTP_USER: cccc@qq.com
         OVERLEAF_EMAIL_SMTP_PASS: xxxxx
         OVERLEAF_EMAIL_SMTP_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTH: true
         OVERLEAF_EMAIL_SMTP_IGNORE_TLS: false
         OVERLEAF_EMAIL_SMTP_NAME: 'My Overleaf 服务'
         OVERLEAF_EMAIL_SMTP_LOGGER: true
         OVERLEAF_CUSTOM_EMAIL_FOOTER: "This system is run by department 林星"

         ################
         ## Server Pro ##
         ################

         # SANDBOXED_COMPILES: 'true'

         # SANDBOXED_COMPILES_SIBLING_CONTAINERS: 'true'
         # SANDBOXED_COMPILES_HOST_DIR: '/var/overleaf_data/data/compiles'
         # SYNCTEX_BIN_HOST_PATH: '/var/overleaf_data/bin/synctex'

         # DOCKER_RUNNER: 'false'

         ## Works with test LDAP server shown at bottom of docker compose
         # OVERLEAF_LDAP_URL: 'ldap://ldap:389'
         # OVERLEAF_LDAP_SEARCH_BASE: 'ou=people,dc=planetexpress,dc=com'
         # OVERLEAF_LDAP_SEARCH_FILTER: '(uid={{username}})'
         # OVERLEAF_LDAP_BIND_DN: 'cn=admin,dc=planetexpress,dc=com'
         # OVERLEAF_LDAP_BIND_CREDENTIALS: 'GoodNewsEveryone'
         # OVERLEAF_LDAP_EMAIL_ATT: 'mail'
         # OVERLEAF_LDAP_NAME_ATT: 'cn'
         # OVERLEAF_LDAP_LAST_NAME_ATT: 'sn'
         # OVERLEAF_LDAP_UPDATE_USER_DETAILS_ON_LOGIN: 'true'

         # OVERLEAF_TEMPLATES_USER_ID: "578773160210479700917ee5"
         # OVERLEAF_NEW_PROJECT_TEMPLATE_LINKS: '[ {"name":"All Templates","url":"/templates/all"}]'


         # OVERLEAF_PROXY_LEARN: "true"
     networks:
         - overleaf-network

 # mongo:
 #     restart: always
 #     image: mongo:latest

 # redis:

overleaf-network:<br>
driver: bridge</p>

 # See https://github.com/jwilder/nginx-proxy for documentation on how to configure the nginx-proxy container,
 # and https://github.com/overleaf/overleaf/wiki/HTTPS-reverse-proxy-using-Nginx for an example of some recommended
 # settings. We recommend using a properly managed nginx instance outside of the Overleaf Server Pro setup,
 # but the example here can be used if you'd prefer to run everything with docker-compose

 #       - /home/overleaf/tmp:/etc/nginx/certs

<li>
<h4 id="mongodocker运行配置">mongodocker运行配置</h4>
<ol>
<li>
<pre><code class="language-yaml"># MongoDB 主节点（node1）
    mongo-node1:
        image: mongo:latest  # 版本按需改4.4
        container_name: mongo-node1
        ports:
            - "27017:27017"
        volumes:
            - D:/docker/volumes/mongo/data/node1:/data/db
            - D:/docker/volumes/mongo/logs/node1:/var/log/mongodb
        command: mongod --replSet rs_overleaf --bind_ip 0.0.0.0
        networks:
            - overleaf-network
        restart: always
        healthcheck:
            test: echo 'db.runCommand("ping").ok' | mongosh localhost:27017/test --quiet
            interval: 10s
            timeout: 10s
            retries: 5
            start_period: 30s

    # MongoDB 从节点（node2）
    mongo-node2:
        image: mongo:latest
        container_name: mongo-node2
        ports:
            - "27018:27017"
        volumes:
            - D:/docker/volumes/mongo/data/node2:/data/db
            - D:/docker/volumes/mongo/logs/node2:/var/log/mongodb
        command: mongod --replSet rs_overleaf --bind_ip 0.0.0.0
        networks:
            - overleaf-network
        restart: always
        depends_on:
            - mongo-node1
        healthcheck:
            test: echo 'db.runCommand("ping").ok' | mongosh localhost:27017/test --quiet
            interval: 10s
            timeout: 10s
            retries: 5
            start_period: 30s
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>这里是配置两个mongo节点的副本集，默认两者是同样优先级，mongo-node2依赖于mongo-node1，因为后面要设置mongo-node1为主节点，mongo-node2为从节点</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>command: mongod --replSet rs_overleaf --bind_ip 0.0.0.0</p>
<ol>
<li>这段命令是：在mongo容器创建后，执行此命令，设置副本集replSet rs_overleaf</li>
<li>--bind_ip 0.0.0.0：允许所有ip访问此节点</li>
</ol>
</li>
<li>
<p>networks:<br>
- overleaf-network</p>
<ol>
<li>这段代码是：配置节点到同一网络，不然的话会默认各个容器直接独立通信</li>
</ol>
</li>
</ol>
</li>
<li>
<h4 id="redis运行配置">redis运行配置</h4>
<ol>
<li>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">redis:
        restart: always
        image: redis:latest
        container_name: redis
        expose:
            - 6379
        volumes:
            - D:/docker/volumes/redis:/data
        command: redis-server --appendonly yes
        networks:
            - overleaf-network
        healthcheck:
            test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
            interval: 10s
            timeout: 5s
            retries: 5
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>networks:<br>
- overleaf-network</p>
<ol>
<li>这段代码是：配置节点到同一网络，不然的话会默认各个容器直接独立通信</li>
</ol>
</li>
</ol>
</li>
<li>
<h4 id="overleaf运行配置">overleaf运行配置</h4>
<ol>
<li>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">overleaf:
        restart: always
        # Server Pro users:
        # image: quay.io/overleaf/overleaf-pro
        image: sharelatex/sharelatex:5.0-with-texlive-full
        # image: sharelatex/sharelatex:5
        container_name: overleaf
        depends_on:
            mongo-node1:
                condition: service_healthy
            mongo-node2:
                condition: service_healthy
            redis:
                condition: service_started
        ports:
            - 9500:80
        links:
            - mongo-node1
            - mongo-node2
            - redis
        volumes:
            - D:/docker/volumes/overleaf:/var/lib/overleaf
            ########################################################################
            ####  Server Pro: Uncomment the following line to mount the docker  ####
            ####             socket, required for Sibling Containers to work    ####
            ########################################################################
            # - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
        environment:

            OVERLEAF_APP_NAME: Overleaf Community Edition

            #OVERLEAF_MONGO_URL: mongodb://mongo/overleaf?replicaSet=rs0
            OVERLEAF_MONGO_URL: mongodb://mongo-node1:27017,mongo-node2:27017/overleaf?replicaSet=rs_overleaf&amp;w=majority&amp;readPreference=primary

            # Same property, unfortunately with different names in
            # different locations
            OVERLEAF_REDIS_HOST: redis
            REDIS_HOST: redis

            ENABLED_LINKED_FILE_TYPES: 'url,project_file'

            # Enables Thumbnail generation using ImageMagick
            ENABLE_CONVERSIONS: 'true'

            # Disables email confirmation requirement
            EMAIL_CONFIRMATION_DISABLED: 'true'

            # temporary fix for LuaLaTex compiles
            # see https://github.com/overleaf/overleaf/issues/695
            TEXMFVAR: /var/lib/overleaf/tmp/texmf-var

            ## Set for SSL via nginx-proxy
            #VIRTUAL_HOST: 103.112.212.22

            # OVERLEAF_SITE_URL: http://overleaf.mydomain.com
            OVERLEAF_NAV_TITLE: Our OVERLEAF Instance
            # OVERLEAF_HEADER_IMAGE_URL: http://somewhere.com/mylogo.png
            OVERLEAF_ADMIN_EMAIL: ccccc@qq.com

            # OVERLEAF_LEFT_FOOTER: '[{"text": "Powered by &lt;a href=\"https://www.overleaf.com\"&gt;Overleaf&lt;/a&gt; 2016"},{"text": "Another page I want to link to can be found &lt;a href=\"here\"&gt;here&lt;/a&gt;"} ]'
            # OVERLEAF_RIGHT_FOOTER: '[{"text": "Hello I am on the Right"} ]'

			# 需要和OVERLEAF_EMAIL_SMTP_USER保持一致才能发送邮件
            OVERLEAF_EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS: "ccccc@qq.com"   

            # OVERLEAF_EMAIL_AWS_SES_ACCESS_KEY_ID:
            # OVERLEAF_EMAIL_AWS_SES_SECRET_KEY:

            OVERLEAF_EMAIL_SMTP_HOST: smtp.qq.com
            OVERLEAF_EMAIL_SMTP_PORT: 465
            OVERLEAF_EMAIL_SMTP_SECURE: true
            OVERLEAF_EMAIL_SMTP_USER: ccccc@qq.com
            OVERLEAF_EMAIL_SMTP_PASS: xxxxxx
            OVERLEAF_EMAIL_SMTP_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTH: true
            OVERLEAF_EMAIL_SMTP_IGNORE_TLS: false
            OVERLEAF_EMAIL_SMTP_NAME: 'My Overleaf 服务'
            OVERLEAF_EMAIL_SMTP_LOGGER: true
            OVERLEAF_CUSTOM_EMAIL_FOOTER: "This system is run by department 林星"

            ################
            ## Server Pro ##
            ################

            # SANDBOXED_COMPILES: 'true'

            # SANDBOXED_COMPILES_SIBLING_CONTAINERS: 'true'
            # SANDBOXED_COMPILES_HOST_DIR: '/var/overleaf_data/data/compiles'
            # SYNCTEX_BIN_HOST_PATH: '/var/overleaf_data/bin/synctex'

            # DOCKER_RUNNER: 'false'

            ## Works with test LDAP server shown at bottom of docker compose
            # OVERLEAF_LDAP_URL: 'ldap://ldap:389'
            # OVERLEAF_LDAP_SEARCH_BASE: 'ou=people,dc=planetexpress,dc=com'
            # OVERLEAF_LDAP_SEARCH_FILTER: '(uid={{username}})'
            # OVERLEAF_LDAP_BIND_DN: 'cn=admin,dc=planetexpress,dc=com'
            # OVERLEAF_LDAP_BIND_CREDENTIALS: 'GoodNewsEveryone'
            # OVERLEAF_LDAP_EMAIL_ATT: 'mail'
            # OVERLEAF_LDAP_NAME_ATT: 'cn'
            # OVERLEAF_LDAP_LAST_NAME_ATT: 'sn'
            # OVERLEAF_LDAP_UPDATE_USER_DETAILS_ON_LOGIN: 'true'

            # OVERLEAF_TEMPLATES_USER_ID: "578773160210479700917ee5"
            # OVERLEAF_NEW_PROJECT_TEMPLATE_LINKS: '[ {"name":"All Templates","url":"/templates/all"}]'
</code></pre>
<pre><code>          # OVERLEAF_PROXY_LEARN: "true"
      networks:
          - overleaf-network
</code></pre>
<pre><code></code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>将所有的sharelatex，全部替换为overleaf，大小写和原来的sharelatex保持一致，(原因：sharelatex版权已经全部归overleaf，对应配置文件也全改成了overleaf，所以要替换）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>mongodb的配置：OVERLEAF_MONGO_URL: mongodb://mongo-node1:27017,mongo-node2:27017/overleaf?replicaSet=rs_overleaf&amp;w=majority&amp;readPreference=primary</p>
<ol>
<li>因为sharelatex要求副本集群部署，所以必须要至少配置两个节点，如果sharelatex是4.xx版本好像可以配置mongo为单副本集也可以用</li>
<li>mongo-node1:27017,mongo-node2:27017，端口号一致，是因为docker容器内部访问，通过名称和默认端口号就可以访问，而mongo-node1:27017,mongo-node2:27018是对外访问端口（通过浏览器之类的应用访问）</li>
</ol>
</li>
<li>
<p>邮箱配置</p>
<ol>
<li>OVERLEAF_EMAIL_SMTP_PORT: 465<br>
OVERLEAF_EMAIL_SMTP_SECURE: true</li>
<li>465端口号是SSL加密协议，OVERLEAF_EMAIL_SMTP_SECURE必须为true   (比较旧的加密协议）</li>
<li>587端口号是TSL加密协议，OVERLEAF_EMAIL_SMTP_SECURE必须为false （比较新的协议）</li>
<li>本人尝试了587端口号，发送邮件后不能被接受，故选择了更通用的465端口号</li>
</ol>
</li>
<li>
<p>networks:<br>
- overleaf-network</p>
<ol>
<li>这段代码是：配置节点到同一网络，不然的话会默认各个容器直接独立通信</li>
</ol>
</li>
</ol>
</li>
<li>
<h4 id="网络设置">网络设置</h4>
<ol>
<li>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">networks:
    overleaf-network:
        driver: bridge

</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>配置服务的公共网络，不然无法进行内容通信连接</p>
</li>
</ol>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="overleaf运行">overleaf运行</h2>
<ol>
<li>
<h4 id="运行docker-composeyml文件启动mongoredisoverleaf文件">运行docker-compose.yml文件，启动mongo，redis，overleaf文件</h4>
<ol>
<li>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 指定项目名为 overleaf-production,不在当前目录，则docker-compose.yml替换为：自己的路径/docker-compose.yml
docker-compose -p overleaf-production -f docker-compose.yml up -d

# 简化写法（如果就在当前目录）
docker-compose -p overleaf-production up -d
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>这个命令会启动以上docker-compose.yml文件中配置的3个文件</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>暂停，关闭，删除可以通过docker desktop软件管理</p>
</li>
</ol>
</li>
<li>
<h4 id="进入mongo容器中检查mongo是否成功">进入mongo容器中检查mongo是否成功</h4>
<ol>
<li>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1937969/202512/1937969-20251201164748461-1057534793.png" alt="image-20251201155226-2n9ts9y" loading="lazy"></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>mongosh：进入数据库shell</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>show dbs：查看数据库</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>配置mongo两个节点为主副关系（若主副节点已经选择则跳过）</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>
<p>（一般是节点比较多自动会选择主副节点，但是实际可能会选择失败）进入的mongo节点（任意一个节点）的exec中，执行下面命令可以配置主副节点</p>
</li>
<li>
<pre><code class="language-bash">mongosh --eval "
cfg = rs.conf();
cfg.members[0].priority = 2;  # 节点1优先级更高
cfg.members[1].priority = 1;  # 节点2优先级较低
rs.reconfig(cfg);
"
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>执行成功会返回如下结果</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">{
  ok: 1,
  '$clusterTime': {
    clusterTime: Timestamp({ t: 1764561551, i: 1 }),
    signature: {
      hash: Binary.createFromBase64('AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=', 0),
      keyId: Long('0')
    }
  },
  operationTime: Timestamp({ t: 1764561551, i: 1 })
}
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>分别在不同的节点中验证是否正确</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">mongosh --eval "
db.isMaster().ismaster ? '✓ 我是主节点 (PRIMARY)' : '✗ 我是从节点 (SECONDARY)'
"
</code></pre>
</li>
</ol>
</li>
</ol>
</li>
<li>
<h4 id="overleaf启动连接mongo问题mongotransactionerror-read-preference-in-a-transaction-must-be-primary-not-primarypreferred">overleaf启动连接mongo问题（MongoTransactionError: Read preference in a transaction must be primary, not: primaryPreferred）</h4>
<ol>
<li>
<ul>
<li><strong>​<code>primaryPreferred</code>​</strong>: 优先从主节点读取，但允许从从节点读取</li>
<li><strong>事务要求</strong>: MongoDB 事务必须在主节点上执行</li>
<li><strong>冲突</strong>: 事务中不能使用非主节点的读取偏好</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>主要修改：</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>从连接字符串中移除 <code>&amp;readPreference=primaryPreferred</code></li>
<li>或者改为 <code>&amp;readPreference=primary</code></li>
<li>重启 Overleaf 服务</li>
</ol>
</li>
</ol>
</li>
<li>
<h4 id="重启overleaf">重启overleaf</h4>
<ol>
<li>
<p>在docker desktop中，删除所以的容器</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>重新运行脚本（c重复第一步骤）</p>
<ol>
<li>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 指定项目名为 overleaf-production,不在当前目录，则docker-compose.yml替换为：自己的路径/docker-compose.yml
docker-compose -p overleaf-production -f docker-compose.yml up -d

# 简化写法（如果就在当前目录）
docker-compose -p overleaf-production up -d
</code></pre>
</li>
</ol>
</li>
</ol>
</li>
<li>
<h4 id="访问验证管理员账号">访问验证&amp;管理员账号</h4>
<ol>
<li>
<p>在浏览器输入：ip:端口号，回车访问</p>
<ol>
<li><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1937969/202512/1937969-20251201164810902-602153371.png" alt="image-20251201161956-r71owy8" loading="lazy"></li>
</ol>
</li>
<li>
<p>初始化管理员账号</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p>进入overleaf的容器（sharelatex镜像启动的容器）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>执行下面命令创建管理员账号</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">grunt user:create-admin --email="admin@example.com" --password="Admin@123456"
</code></pre>
</li>
</ol>
</li>
<li>
<p>浏览器输入邮箱密码，即可登录</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1937969/202512/1937969-20251201164823996-954153572.png" alt="image-20251201162309-d5yw6zw" loading="lazy"></p>
</li>
</ol>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="overleaf更新texlive">overleaf更新texlive</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>官网链接：<a href="https://github.com/overleaf/toolkit/blob/master/doc/ce-upgrading-texlive.md" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">toolkit/doc/ce-upgrading-texlive.md at master · overleaf/toolkit · GitHub</a></p>
</blockquote>
<ol>
<li>
<h4 id="检查tlmgr更新">检查tlmgr&amp;更新</h4>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># tlmgr --version
tlmgr revision 59291 (2021-05-21 05:14:40 +0200)
tlmgr using installation: /usr/local/texlive/2021
TeX Live (https://tug.org/texlive) version 2021

// 更新tlmgr命令
# tlmgr update --self
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<h4 id="下载全量texlive">下载全量texlive</h4>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># tlmgr install scheme-full
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<h4 id="查看tlmgr命令帮助">查看tlmgr命令帮助</h4>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># tlmgr help
</code></pre>
</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>注意：</strong> tlmgr为texlive的命令，没有的话，需要按照texlive才能用</p>

</div>
